d:
In this video, we discuss about political strategist turned politician Prashant Kishor and his party Jan Suraj, which did not manage to win even one seat and at many constituencies got even less votes than NOTA.
We discuss in this video the issues that Prashant Kishor highlighted that became talk of various parties' election campaigns. We also discuss what lies in the future for Kishor and his party. We talk about how he managed to make his name known nationwide and even if he has lost drastically, what can he and the state do in the future?
Anchor: Satyam
Script: Gaurav
Camera: Abhishek
